invitations.name: How's my business doing?
invitations.prompt: How's my business doing, what needs attention, and what should we work on today? Reporting period: Last 30 days.

invitations.name: Ask VERA to review the evidence
invitations.prompt: VERA, review my business performance, financial evidence and risks. Use permitted business evidence, explain sources, periods and unavailable information, and recommend one to three grounded priorities. PAIGE remains my COO. Do not take an action. Reporting period: Last 30 days.

invitations.name: Review targets with PAIGE
invitations.prompt: Review my saved Strategic Play targets and compatible actuals. Focus the business review on game_plan. Explain variance, periods and unknowns, and link me to the owning Plays. Do not take an action. Reporting period: Last 30 days.

invitations.name: Discuss with PAIGE
invitations.prompt: Help me understand this Operations & Systems Check finding and recommend a next step: 2 blocking operating findings. Re-read the current business evidence; do not take an action. Reporting period: Last 30 days.

invitations.name: Review with PAIGE
